offering_description.value: Provides cloud payroll, HR, benefits, talent and workforce management software and outsourced services to employers of all sizes. It runs payroll and tax filings for clients and earns fees per employee processed and per service used.

primary_products.value: payroll software; HR management software; benefits administration platforms; time and attendance systems; talent management software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; tax filing; HR outsourcing; benefits administration; professional employer organization services

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers of all sizes, from small businesses to large enterprises; B2G: state and local government agencies

end_markets.value: professional services; manufacturing; healthcare; retail; financial services

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-employee payroll processing and HR outsourcing fees; subscription: recurring software and cloud platform subscriptions; interest or premiums: interest earned on client funds held before payment
revenue_model.category: service fees; subscription; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs payroll, tax and HR operations for employer clients; software / platform: cloud HR and payroll platforms sold to employers; financial intermediary: moves client payroll and tax funds to employees and agencies
value_chain_position.category: service provider; software / platform; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States as largest market, plus many countries in Europe, Asia and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, HR, benefits, talent management and insurance services sharing employer customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to employers and large enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: accounting firms and technology partners referring clients; online: online self-service platforms and app marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing, employment, benefits and data privacy rules enforced by tax authorities and labor regulators, some brokerage activities are registered
